senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="P01077">same</cite> <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 14:45">Targ. Lev. XIV, 45</cite>.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 8:26">Targ. Prov. VIII, 26</cite> (h. text <he>עפרות</he>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:10">B. Bath. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה שקיל ע׳ ומורח וכ׳</he> he took up dust and smelt of it and said, this is the road &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 16a:15">Ib. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ לפומיה דאיוב</he> earth into Job’s mouth (stop him)! Ib. 171ᵇ <he>מאן יהיב לן מעַפְרֵיה דרב וכ׳</he> O, that some one would give us some of the dust of Rab and Samuel, and we should put it into our eyes! (i.e. we surely revere the memory of Rab and Samuel, yet we differ with them); <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 53b">Ab. Zar. 53ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 68b">Ḥull. 68ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:21">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>והוה … ע׳ והוו חרבי</he> we threw dust and it turned into swords; a. fr.
